newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 27.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, Wall Street was closed for Memorial Day.

* Indonesian police have said last week's riot and arson which ended with more than 130 dead in the Kalimantan city of Banjarmasin was not an act of subversion, the official Antara news agency reported on Monday.
* On Monday, the composite index rose 4.67 points, or 0.71 percent, to 663.20 points on bargain-hunting in blue chip counters led by Telkom, brokers said.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,438.50/49.50 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,437.50/38.50.
* Surabaya-based property firm Mas Murni Indonesia on revived market talk that the firm is a target of a take-over bid.
* Departement-store Ramayana Lestari after it announced sharply higher first quarter earnings of 39.89 billion rupiah, against 25 billion rupiah in the same period in 1996.
* Semen Gresik on possible bargain-hunting after its shares price fell following its lower-than-expected first quarter earnings.
* Secondary plastic firm Dynaplast on news reports the firm planned to buy a 26-percent stake in an Indian plastic packaging firm.
* Pulp and paper maker Indah Kiat after it announced a plan to sell power plants to an affiliated company in an effort to trim debt.
* Small tourism services firm Bayu Buana on reports of a possible financial restructuring.
